data.text: The neighborhood repair clinic opens May 21 at the Eastside Library. Volunteers will offer bicycle tune-ups from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. The library's book sale remains scheduled for May 14 in the adjoining hall.
changes: Updated the repair clinic date and split the announcement for readability.

data.text: The neighborhood repair clinic opens May 14 at the Eastside Library. Volunteers will offer bicycle tune-ups from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. The library's book sale is also scheduled for May 14 in the adjoining hall.
changes: Made the announcement easier to read while keeping both events distinct.

data.text: Priya Nair coordinates the river survey and receives volunteer sign-ups. Luis Ortega manages the water-quality samples, while the Parks Office supplies the sampling kits.
changes: Updated the coordinator and volunteer sign-up contact.

data.text: The pantry will pack 300 weekend meal bags for the spring distribution. Each bag contains two breakfasts and one shelf-stable dinner. Another 60 hygiene kits are already assembled for pickup.
changes: Updated the planned meal-bag total and clarified that the hygiene kits are separate.

data.text: The facilities team has approved the courtyard mural. The artist's color study was approved last week, and the scaffolding reservation is confirmed for June 3.
changes: Updated the facilities approval status and tightened the opening sentence.

data.text: The public compost pilot starts July 15, with six collection bins at the north entrance. Nadia Brooks leads the pilot; the garden team will continue its separate Saturday soil workshops through August.
changes: Updated the pilot's start date, bin count, and lead.

data.text: The museum's oral-history recording day is listed for September 12 in Studio B. The volunteer orientation is on September 5 in the main gallery, and registration closes September 9.

The neighborhood council approved the courtyard fountain proposal at Tuesday's meeting. The library's seed exchange opens at nine. A contractor will repaint the south stairwell next month. The bicycle racks beside the hall hold twelve bikes.
changes: Updated the fountain proposal's decision status.

data.text: The neighborhood council did not decide on the courtyard fountain proposal at Tuesday's meeting and will revisit it next month. The library's seed exchange opens at nine. A contractor will repaint the south stairwell next month. The bicycle racks beside the hall hold twelve bikes.
changes: Updated the fountain proposal's decision status and next review timing.

data.text: The coastal observatory has cancelled its November public telescope nights and will not host any sessions that month. Its weather station sends readings every hour. The visitor center sells printed sky maps. A new footbridge crosses the marsh trail.
changes: Updated the November telescope program status.

data.text: The coastal observatory has postponed the November start of its public telescope nights until a permit is issued. No new date is confirmed. Its weather station sends readings every hour. The visitor center sells printed sky maps. A new footbridge crosses the marsh trail.
changes: Updated the telescope program's postponement and date status.

data.text: The ceramics workshop is scheduled for Sunday, and registration is closed. The workshop will provide clay and aprons. The garden club waters the planters on Mondays. The town clock was restored last spring. The café closes at six.
changes: Updated the workshop day, registration status, and apron provision.

data.text: The museum's oral-history room is closed for repairs until Friday. The archive desk still accepts appointment requests by email. The sculpture garden opens at ten. The café serves lunch from noon to three.
The ferry office posts tide notices each morning. The pier clock runs five minutes fast. The ticket window closes at seven. A volunteer group collects litter on the west beach.
